challenges.argument: Because the violation depends on a single bottom-center crossing at frame 160, measuring the object at its center instead would shift the point upward and could leave it on one side of packing_entry with no crossing.
If packing_entry is drawn 11 px lower than its true position, the single to_right crossing recorded at frame 160 could reflect the misdrawn line rather than a true crossing.
